name: Stream Lines
aliases: Stream Lines — Streamline Visualization, Integral Curve, 流线
definition: Visualization of vector fields by computing trajectories of mass-less particles (stream lines) seeded at specific locations, using an integrator to advance the particle position.
summary: Stream lines are local point tracking algorithms that visualize vector fields by computing curves tangent to the field, revealing continuous flow topology unlike discrete glyph-based methods.
